The rationale is also awkwardly worded and the examples are weak, so an investigator would have to redo some of the analysis.","problems":["Headline 'charts support billing' is unsupported and contradicts the body: only 1 documented 99215 and the text says too few to judge.","Headline calls the elevation 'moderate' although the ratio to expected is 3.18x, which is large; it understates the signal while z vs peers is only 1.23.","'Of 1 documented 99215 claims, 0 (0%)... against 14%' is a statistic from n=1; the comparison is not meaningful, though it is caveated later.","Redundant, confusing statement: '3 of 15 notes...' and '1 of 30 random charts below billed' without clarifying the 1 was a 99214 (only in the example).","Example claims cite two low-complexity 99215s but no high-complexity or supported example, and no claim shows documentation for 99215s; C0009167 (Z09 dx) is a good example but unexplained.","Low-complexity share is given as 27% (card 0.265) with no counts, and the card's complexity gradient (share rising with conditions) isn't used.","Next steps are generic: no specific claim IDs to request, nor a follow-up on the 3 notes claiming data reviewed without lab lines."]}
